low_power_modes_summary.Normal_operation_PD_1: PD=1, PLL locked, TMDS drivers active, encoder running; I_DD typ 200 mA, max 250 mA at worst-case checkerboard pattern.
low_power_modes_summary.TMDS_disabled_TDIS_1: TDIS=1, PD=1: TMDS drivers gated to V_OFF but PLL stays locked (fast re-enable).
low_power_modes_summary.Power_down_PD_0: Only digital I/O buffers + I2C interface remain active; TMDS drivers, PLL, encoders, serializers all gated. I_PD typ 200 µA, max 500 µA.
low_power_modes_summary.VEN_HEN_off: VEN=0 or HEN=0 forces VSYNC / HSYNC to fixed LOW at the TMDS output; does NOT reduce supply current significantly but disables sync transmission for test or specific receiver compatibility.

power_supply_domains.name: PV_DD
power_supply_domains.purpose: PLL supply (with on-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass).

power_supply_domains.name: TV_DD
power_supply_domains.purpose: TMDS differential output driver supply (delivers current set by R_TFADJ).

power_wakeup_specification.PD_assertion_to_TMDS_valid: PLL lock time (few µs typical) after PD=1 issued via pin or register.
power_wakeup_specification.TDIS_assertion_to_TMDS_valid: Near-instantaneous (PLL stays locked); microseconds for driver enable.
power_wakeup_specification.I2C_active_in_PD_mode: Yes — I2C target remains responsive in PD=0; host can read VEN_ID/DEV_ID and write CTL_1_MODE to enable.

power_classes_of_implementations: Always-on PC desktop monitor — PD=1 throughout; PLL never gated.
Battery-powered portable device — PD=0 during sleep; PD=1 on user wake.
TDIS-gated runtime power management — quick mute of TMDS for transitions / blanking without full PLL re-lock.
fields.notes: TFP410 power intent is straightforward: 3 supplies (DV_DD / PV_DD / TV_DD all at 3.3 V), 3 grounds (DGND / PGND / TGND), and three power states (full-on / TDIS-gated / power-down). On-chip 1.8 V regulators + bypass capacitors isolate PLL from supply noise. Power-down current is conservative (200-500 µA) but not as low as some modern HDMI transmitters because TFP410 keeps the I2C target alive for fast wake-up. No isolation cells or retention registers documented — the PLL re-locks from scratch after PD=0→1.
